LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Thornshell.nodes.0.label: Riveted Thorns
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Thornshell.nodes.0.descri: Retains original retaliation, health and defense. New branches require original retaliation to actually damage an enemy. Being attacked alone, fully blocked retaliation, friendly fire and secondary hits do not count. Progression stays with the relic.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Thornshell.nodes.1.label: Barbed Pursuit
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Thornshell.nodes.1.descri: After original retaliation actually damages an enemy, mark it for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on that enemy consumes the mark for 50 damage. One mark maximum; retaliation itself cannot spend it. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Thornshell.nodes.2.label: Briar Cover
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Thornshell.nodes.2.descri: After original retaliation actually damages an enemy, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Thornshell.nodes.3.label: Splintered Barbs
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Thornshell.nodes.3.descri: After Barbed Pursuit actually deals its bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. Never strikes the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Thornshell.nodes.4.label: Briar Stitch
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Thornshell.nodes.4.descri: After Barbed Pursuit actually deals its bonus damage, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Cannot restore permanent scars or missing parts; prevented bonus damage grants nothing. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Thornshell.nodes.5.label: Briar Relief
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Thornshell.nodes.5.descri: After original retaliation actually damages an enemy, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Selects independently from the shield; does not heal you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Thornshell.nodes.6.label: Gathered Barbs
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Thornshell.nodes.6.descri: After original retaliation actually damages an enemy, store one barb for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit consumes it for 50 damage. One barb maximum; retaliation itself cannot spend it. Base rewards: damage 50.
